units.source_text: 两三个小时之后，信子再次坐上人力车，向着电车终点站新开发区奔去。

en.t: Two or three hours later, Nobuko got into a rickshaw again and hurried toward the newly developed district at the end of the tram line.

units.source_text: 透过摇晃的人力车前篷的私房窗口，照子望着外面的风景。

en.t: Through the little window of the shaking rickshaw's front hood, Teruko looked out at the scenery.

units.source_text: 城郊附近的房子、染上秋色的杂木树渐渐远去。

en.t: The houses near the edge of town and the mixed trees tinged with autumn colors gradually receded into the distance.

units.source_text: 假如要找出什么永恒不变的物体，可能只有秋日天空薄薄的浮云吧。

en.t: If one were to look for something eternal and unchanging, perhaps it would be only the thin drifting clouds in the autumn sky.
